description: A function that changes state is marked idempotent, so an automated retry would add the task twice.

input.assignment: Write a module for a to-do list kept in memory. It exports three functions that an llm call will be given as tools, so give each one a description the LLM will see, covering what it does and each parameter. `addTask(title: string, due: string = ""): string` adds a task and returns a short confirmation. `completeTask(title: string): string` marks the task with that exact title done and returns a short confirmation, or a message saying no such task exists. `listOpenTasks(): string[]` returns the titles of the tasks not yet done, in the order they were added.
